history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Empty Container Admission details.
features: Each container gate out need permission, so the user can use Empty Container Admission to generate a notification to Akras Logistics with selected empty containers for customs approval.
Last activity should be DE / RE / EA
Previous Activity should be OE or OF

events.description: Opens the Empty Container Admission screen in a new tab next to Depot Activity.
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near Depot Activity and clicks Empty Container Admission.

events.description: Queries the containers matching the query fields and lists them in the grid, with the total in Total Container(s).
events.triggered_when: User enters From / To Date and Activity Place (mandatory), plus any optional fields, and clicks Search.

events.description: Generates a notification to Akras Logistics with the selected empty containers for customs approval.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more containers using the check boxes and clicks Process.

events.description: Exports the containers listed in the grid to an Excel file.
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Excel icon after querying containers.

events.description: Reloads the grid with the latest data for the current query.
Shows or hides the query fields panel.
events.triggered_when: User clicks the arrow at the right of the search box.

search.name: From / To Date
search.ui: Mandatory. Input From and To date

search.name: Voyage
search.ui: Input Voyage. The ⇆ switches the box between Auto Populate (Key in three char) and Alphanumeric

search.name: Activity Place
search.ui: Mandatory. Key in five char and select Activity Place from the list

search.name: Previous Activity
search.ui: Select Previous Activity from the list

search.name: Search
search.ui: Queries the containers based on the query fields
